activity.notes: Pope Gregory I addressed a letter in 594 to Hospito as 'Duke of the Barbaricini'. ATLAS records 594 only as a representative attestation point for Hospito's political leadership, not as a fabricated full reign interval, and uses the historically attested Barbaricini community rather than the broader geographic label Barbagia.

sources.title: Gregory the Great, Book IV, Letter XXIII: To Hospito, Duke of the Barbaricini
sources.citation_text: Gregory I's 594 letter is explicitly addressed to Hospito as Duke of the Barbaricini and praises his Christian allegiance among his people.
